# MindForm

> MindForm is a free, private productivity dashboard for habit tracking, minute-level task planning, long-term goals and discipline streaks — in one Apple-inspired interface.

MindForm is a full-stack productivity ecosystem that helps people build discipline through data-driven habit tracking, task management, goal progression and psychological wellness monitoring. It is 100% free and open source.

## Core modules

- **Task Tracker**: weekly minute-level planner with day-by-day checkboxes, week score, next-task timer, insights, weekly reflection prompts and CSV export.
- **Habit Tracker**: 30-day habit matrix with streaks, completion rates, daily/weekly charts, mood and motivation tracking (1-10 scale), and CSV export.
- **Goals**: create career, health, personal or general goals with deadlines, categories, statuses and progress computed from linked tasks and habits.
- **Fapless**: a discipline streak engine with 10 identity levels (Novice → Legend), milestone bonuses, challenges (30-day, 90-day protocol), relapse history with reasons and aura points.
- **Social Hub**: opt-in public profiles, a global leaderboard ranked by streak, a follow system and a private community forum where messages auto-delete after 48 hours.
- **AI Coach**: a chat interface with your data in context. Works with Google Gemini or Mistral models; you bring your own API key, which is stored only in your browser.

## Privacy model

- Tasks, habits and goals are stored privately in your account and scoped to your user ID.
- AI chat history is automatically deleted every 24 hours.
- Community forum messages automatically delete after 48 hours (TTL index).
- Profiles are private by default; you opt in to appear on the leaderboard.
- Disposable email providers are blocked; bot protection uses honeypots and rate limiting.

## Technology

- Frontend: React 18, Vite, Recharts, GSAP, Lenis smooth scrolling, Lucide icons.
- Backend: Node.js, Express, JWT auth, Helmet, rate limiting, MongoDB (Mongoose).

## Links

- Live app: https://mindform.onrender.com/
- Docs and self-hosting: see the repository README.

## Pricing

MindForm is free forever. There are no paid tiers.
